name: Angelo Moraca
bioAdditions: Angelo Paolo was baptized on 10 February 1744, son of Antonino Moraca and Teresa Sposata (S1). His parents are new to the tree. His godfather was Gaetano Ferlaino, himself John's ancestor.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Tree data match an indexed San Mango parish entry (derivative index of a primary register; image online but not read by me).
